features.name: Long-bladed version is approximately human-forearm length; distinguish from normal-knife-sized short version.
Double-edged combat blade with advanced edge/bonding technology.

Follow the own published family outline: closed simple dark grip/pommel, small near-perpendicular metal guard and straight double-edged metal blade tapering to an angular spear point. No sculpted oversized guard or open pommel loop from the separately approved local custom design.
Long/Short exterior proportions are explicit text-constrained interpretations of a shared family illustration, not independent variant artwork.

Root inspected the prepared overlay against the single accepted raw pair. Paired silhouette and landmarks remain aligned; each source mask retains its own components/openings, with no discarded components or filled holes. Thin members and structural openings retained. Fine grooves/seams are nonblocking. Native1254 images retained;2048 is resampled, not native2K. Root reviewed actual long Fineblade detail and matching clay against Arsenal14/PDF16 own family silhouette/text and172/PDF174 table. Long version is a forearm-length interpretation with longer blade than short; shared family illustration is not variant-labeled. Straight double-edged spearpoint, closed grip/pommel, small transverse guard and major bevels remain. Precise proportions, finish, small fittings and unseen depth are artistic. The final clay removes surface fittings while preserving construction; shallow channel nonblocking. No replacement or change to approved custom native Cougars. Actual returned images and alpha comparison reviewed; no opaque background, clipping or cast shadow.
